consumer.use: Decide whether the R3 v2 one-slot invariant preserves the semantically reviewed R3 correction and fixes the rejected author-head publication-completeness defect before any Natural-Pilot activation.

decision_target.question: Does R3 v2 preserve exactly one fixed consumed slot and zero accepted natural evidence for an experiment-influenced fully provable post-A birth, while also freezing every affected commit-required CI-blocking generated projection before review?

intervention.name: explicit one-slot-before-gates invariant
intervention.description: Construct canonical birth identity and fixed ordinal before naturalness/self-interference; explicitly forbid only zero slots for a fully proved interfered birth, while Phase G independently forbids natural-evidence acceptance.

control_condition.description: Frozen R3 v1 author head 84ec97c7b76609fa5ef04ccc744de0a030dd8714 on PR #356. Its exact-head review blocked all seven one-slot semantic attacks but returned REJECT_THIS_REVISION because the head omitted the commit-required CI-blocking generated document index; GitHub validate independently failed on the same omission.

treatment_condition.description: R3 v2 keeps the reviewed R01-R09 semantics, including R03 => assigned=1, consumed=1, accepted_natural_evidence=0, and adds a frozen-head requirement that regeneration of every CI-blocking generated artifact is clean.

measurement.method: Freeze a separate R3 v2 author commit only after running the canonical blocking-artifact generator and committing its output. Keep every counter-hypothesis pending/not_checked and no result verdict. Then require an independent exact-head reviewer to attempt the seven semantic attacks plus an eighth clean-regeneration attack. No natural candidate is observed and no pilot is activated.
measurement.success: All seven one-slot semantic attacks are blocked, no prospective review label leaks, regeneration of all CI-blocking generated artifacts leaves the frozen author head clean, and the independent reviewer reports zero material findings.
measurement.falsification: Any protocol-conforming semantic escape, premature favorable label, dirty blocking-artifact regeneration, missing commit-required projection, or other material exact-head finding rejects this revision without repairing the frozen author files.

cost_metric.method: Record reviewer runtime as descriptive overhead only.

comparison.unit: three frozen R3 v1 publication-failure facts versus one separately frozen R3 v2 protocol and nine adversarial cases
comparability_constraints: R3 v1 frozen author head 84ec97c7b76609fa5ef04ccc744de0a030dd8714 and its five author files remain unchanged negative evidence
R3 v1 exact-head review blocked all seven preregistered one-slot semantic attacks
R3 v1 exact-head review and GitHub CI independently identified the missing commit-required generated document index as material
canonical candidate identity and authoritative event-id ordering remain unchanged
R01-R09 one-slot semantics remain unchanged, including R03 = assigned 1, consumed 1, natural 0
activation boundary A and target N are not chosen here
no natural candidate is observed or consumed
R3 v2 review is bound to one exact frozen author commit after blocking generated artifacts are committed
confounders: paper agreement cannot establish live event-journal completeness
one independent reviewer may still share conceptual priors with the author
slot precision does not establish Outcome Case efficacy, prevalence or cost

allowed: frozen rejected R3 v1 author head 84ec97c7b76609fa5ef04ccc744de0a030dd8714 and PR #356 review result
independent R3 v2 exact-head review receipt/output
canonical blocking generated-artifact regeneration and Git status evidence
future completeness-reporting Bureau event-journal receipt only for later activation

reviewed_exception.rationale: R3 v2 is a separate paper/adversarial successor to a semantically sound but publication-incomplete rejected author head. It changes no runtime authority and adds the missing generated-projection freeze discipline.
